answer.summary: API types check failed because the committed src/utils/api-types.d.ts is out of date with the backend API. The generator produced a diff for CatalogHistoryOutput.catalog_history_action (a union type reformatted across lines), and the script then asked for regeneration before committing. This is deterministic and will repeat on re-run; fix by running yarn generate-types-from-api and committing the updated api-types.d.ts.
